enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Sonic Blast 3: This weapon rings with the power of sound, dealing 3d6 Sonic damage on a successful hit, and an additional 3d6 Sonic damage on a critical hit.
Reverberating 3: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 3d6 sonic damage on each hit.

Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every three seconds.
Vampirism 1: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +1d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
